title: Fizzy King 100ml Shortfill 0mg (70VG/30PG)
description:
Bringing their 100ml of fizzy and fruity flavoured 70PG/30VG e-liquids, Fizzy King’s 0mg nicotine shortfills will keep you refreshed during hot days. With six sizzling flavours, each Fizzy King shortfill is ideal for Sub-Ohm vaping that allows for a much smoother inhale that largely avoids hits to the throat and creates bigger vapour clouds as you exhale with tanks and kits. If you’re missing nicotine, you can add up to two nicotine shots to grant yourself that carving that successfully emulates the feeling of smoking tobacco cigarettes during your vaping.
– Made in the UK
– 0mg Nicotine Strength
– 100ml E-Liquid Content in a 120ml Shortfill Bottle
– Space for 2 x 10ml (18mg) Nicotine shots
– 70VG/30PG
– Ideal for Sub-Ohm Devices and Kits
– Childproof Cap and Tamper Evident Seal
– Recyclable Bottle
– TPD Complaint
Flavours:
Grape Lemonade
Lemonade
Original Cola
Pink Lemonade
Red Energy
Summer Fizz Punch
